data.speaker: Priya Nair
data.text: Good morning everyone, thanks for joining the weekly review.

data.speaker: Priya Nair
data.text: Rakesh ji, aap sun paa rahe hain?

data.speaker: Rakesh Agarwal
data.text: Haan Priya, clearly sun raha hoon.

data.speaker: Rakesh Agarwal
data.text: Sunita bhi mere saath baithi hai, she is joining from my phone.

data.speaker: Priya Nair
data.text: Perfect, so three things today: occupancy, the F&B costing, and the duty roster.

data.speaker: Arjun Mehta
data.text: October occupancy closed at 72 percent, up from 64 in September.

data.speaker: Arjun Mehta
data.text: ARR was 4,850 rupees, slightly below the 5,000 target.

data.speaker: Rakesh Agarwal
data.text: Weekend pe toh full tha, weekdays mein problem hai.

data.speaker: Priya Nair
data.text: Yes, corporate weekday business is what we need to build.

data.speaker: Priya Nair
data.text: Arjun will share a corporate outreach list by Friday.

data.speaker: Arjun Mehta
data.text: Haan, Friday tak bhej dunga, around forty companies in Udaipur and Ahmedabad.

data.speaker: Rakesh Agarwal
data.text: Theek hai, and please copy Sunita on that mail.

data.speaker: Priya Nair
data.text: Noted, Sunita will be copied.

data.speaker: Priya Nair
data.text: Next, the F&B costing model we discussed last month.

data.speaker: Arjun Mehta
data.text: Food cost is running at 38 percent against a target of 32.

data.speaker: Rakesh Agarwal
data.text: Yeh bahut zyada hai, kitchen mein wastage ho raha hai kya?

data.speaker: Arjun Mehta
data.text: Partly wastage, partly the banquet menu is priced too low for the portions.

data.speaker: Priya Nair
data.text: We propose a revised banquet menu with new portion sizes and a 12 percent price revision.

data.speaker: Rakesh Agarwal
data.text: Twelve percent is okay for the December weddings, but not before Diwali bookings close.

data.speaker: Priya Nair
data.text: Agreed, so the revised menu applies to bookings taken from 15 November.

data.speaker: Arjun Mehta
data.text: DNY will send the revised menu card and costing sheet by 10 November.

data.speaker: Rakesh Agarwal
data.text: Done, main 12 tak approve kar dunga.

data.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
data.text: Ek baat, the vegetarian thali feedback was very good at the Sharma wedding.

data.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
data.text: Please keep that thali in the new menu.

data.speaker: Priya Nair
data.text: Absolutely, we will keep it and maybe add a Rajasthani special.

data.speaker: Priya Nair
data.text: Third point, the duty roster for housekeeping.

data.speaker: Arjun Mehta
data.text: We have two staff on long leave, so weekend coverage is thin.

data.speaker: Rakesh Agarwal
data.text: Do log aur hire kar lo, but salary 14,000 se zyada nahi.

data.speaker: Priya Nair
data.text: We will put out the vacancies this week and share profiles with you.

data.speaker: Rakesh Agarwal
data.text: Interviews main khud lunga, Sunday ko hotel pe.

data.speaker: Arjun Mehta
data.text: The GST filing for October is also due on the 20th, we need the bank statement from your side.

data.speaker: Rakesh Agarwal
data.text: Sunita, kal accountant se statement mangwa do.

data.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
data.text: Haan, kal subah bhej dungi.

data.speaker: Priya Nair
data.text: One risk to flag: the OTA commission on MakeMyTrip went up to 22 percent from this month.

data.speaker: Rakesh Agarwal
data.text: Yeh toh bahut hai, direct booking badhao.

data.speaker: Priya Nair
data.text: We will push the website booking engine with a 5 percent direct discount, starting next week.

data.speaker: Rakesh Agarwal
data.text: Okay, try karo, but weekend rates mat girao.

data.speaker: Arjun Mehta
data.text: Understood, the discount applies to weekday bookings only.

data.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
data.text: Ek question, the lobby renovation, kab start hoga?

data.speaker: Priya Nair
data.text: The contractor has not confirmed a date yet, we will chase him and revert.

data.speaker: Rakesh Agarwal
data.text: Please do, January se pehle ho jaana chahiye.

data.speaker: Priya Nair
data.text: Let us meet again next Monday, same time, 10:30.

data.speaker: Rakesh Agarwal
data.text: Monday theek hai.

data.speaker: Priya Nair
data.text: Thank you all, I will send the notes today.

data.speaker: Sunita Agarwal
data.text: Thank you Priya, bye.
